title: Fourier orthogonality of cube monomials
statement: For any two sets of coordinates $S,T$ in a finite sign cube, the Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the monomial $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ is $1$ if $S=T$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ and $T$ are subsets of the same finite coordinate set
